dag.description: XGBoost complete end-to-end pipeline for a US DNR/contact-risk model (e.g. crm_us). A single calibration-split inference fans out to (a) PiperMetricGeneration that publishes model metrics to PIPER and (b) ModelCalibration (sigmoid/isotonic) that feeds Package -> Registration. No held-out testing branch and no model wiki.

agent_context.when_to_use: XGBoost tabular classifier (e.g. crm_us US DNR contact-risk model) that publishes calibration-split metrics to PIPER for monitoring and applies sigmoid/isotonic ModelCalibration before packaging. Use when you have only training + calibration splits (no separate testing split) and consume metrics through PIPER.
agent_context.when_not_to_use: If you have a separate held-out testing split (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_piper_testing). If you publish a model wiki instead of PIPER metrics (use xgboost_complete_e2e_with_wiki_and_model_calibration). If you calibrate with percentile bucketing.
differentiators: Metrics published via PiperMetricGeneration_calibration (PIPER) instead of ModelMetricsComputation/ModelWikiGenerator
Metrics computed on the calibration split (no separate testing branch)
Single XGBoostModelInference_calibration forks to PIPER metrics AND ModelCalibration

prerequisites.check: Training + calibration Cradle SQL / dataset splits
prerequisites.how: two Cradle SQL blocks (or two job_type splits)
PiperMetricGeneration config points at a valid PIPER metric namespace

common_pitfalls: PiperMetricGeneration and ModelCalibration share the same XGBoostModelInference_calibration output
Package registers the ModelCalibration output, not raw XGBoostTraining
No testing branch - metrics reflect the calibration split
